title: 首播28天：8200万户在看，丹伯里夫人凭啥出圈？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Listen, if you are being into 82 million households in the first 28 days of broadcasting, it's different from doing a big movie or anything else that you are ubiquitous.
segments.zh: 听着，如果你在播出前28天内进入8200万户家庭，那和拍一部大电影或其他任何你无处不在的事情是不同的。

segments.en: Adjoa Ando, on being Bridgerton's Lady Danbury.
segments.zh: 阿乔阿·安多，饰演《布里奇顿》的丹伯里夫人。

segments.en: Of course, your majesty, but remember, a young lady cannot be a diamond until you annoy her as such.
segments.zh: 当然，陛下，但请记住，一位年轻女士只有在您如此认可她时才能成为钻石。

segments.en: What are your favourite Danbury lines? I like it when she's having fun. I love it when she'd kick back and have a...
segments.zh: 你最喜欢的丹伯里台词是什么？我喜欢她玩得开心的时候。我喜欢她放松下来，然后……

segments.en: she'd have a fag on the go and a drink. I love that sort of just appetite and then...
segments.zh: 她会抽根烟喝杯酒。我喜欢那种纯粹的欲望，然后……

segments.en: Here I am. Any actor who wants to stay interested in the part they're playing, you have to put some blood into the writer's words.
segments.zh: 我在这里。任何演员要想对自己扮演的角色保持兴趣，就必须给作家的文字注入一些心血。

segments.en: From Bloomberg Weekend, this is the Michelle Hussain show.
segments.zh: 来自彭博周末，这里是米歇尔·侯赛因秀。

segments.en: Bridgerton has been a global TV phenomenon for more than six years now.
segments.zh: 《布里奇顿》成为全球电视现象已经六年多了。

segments.en: From the moment the first episode dropped right up to and through this year's season 4.
segments.zh: 从第一集播出到今年的第四季，一直如此。

segments.en: And all the way through this tale of Regency England with its modern twists, there is one character who is not only very present but who I think has a particular role for the viewer.
segments.zh: 在这个带有现代元素的摄政时代英国故事中，有一个角色不仅非常突出，而且我认为她对观众有着特殊的意义。

segments.en: Lady Danbury is kind of like the audience's guide, their friend even.
segments.zh: 丹伯里夫人就像是观众的向导，甚至是他们的朋友。
